key_insight: svMultiPhysics is an open-source finite element solver that unifies cardiovascular solid, fluid, diffusion, and electrophysiology simulations in a modular multiphysics framework.
engineering_relevance: It helps researchers run patient-specific cardiovascular studies in a single platform, supporting more realistic modeling of cardiac and vascular interactions for diagnosis and treatment research.
method: C++ parallel finite element solver for PDE-based cardiovascular modeling
Supports independent or coupled simulation of mechanics, flow, diffusion, and electrophysiology
Designed for seamless module coupling in the SimVascular open-source ecosystem
evidence_signal: The abstract reports preliminary GPU-enabled runs achieving up to about 30× wall-clock speedup for selected linear solver configurations compared with CPU-based simulations.
watch_item: The reported speedup is preliminary and limited to selected linear solver setups, so performance may vary across full coupled workflows and problem sizes.
paper_title: svMultiPhysics: a finite element-based solver for cardiovascular simulations
